name: Horse
description: A numerous and favored mount to take into battle.
specialRules: Horses have difficulty moving over difficult terrain-every space of movement over, onto, and off of difficult terrain costs thrice as much as standard.

name: Griffin
description: Horse-like creatures with the head and wings of an eagle, allowing flight.

name: Pegasus
description: Majestic equine creatures with great feathery wings, said to have come from Heaven by some faiths.

name: Flying Broom
description: Magically enchanted broomsticks that are favored flying devices of wizards.
specialRules: A broom cannot move on the ground; it must be flying to move.
